notes.title: Bugfix and Improvement Patch 0.1.5
notes.notes:
New bugfix patch is out!
[b]
Demo Patch 0.1.5 Notes[/b]

Bug fixes and improvements:
 - Fixed issue where items would be floating in the air if the player spawns inside a sky tram tower.
 - Improved sky tram routing thanks to the glitchy seed found by Skish
 - Throwing items in VR now transfers more momentum from the hand, allowing you to throw further.
 - Bottles now break more easily
 - Reduced the frequency of gym interiors, there were way too many of them.
 - Fixed ground shadows sometimes persisting where they should be removed.
 - Fixed items floating in the air near building entrances.

Also, I am now working on the NPC spawn and schedule system and I have something very cool planned for it. However, I can't talk about it until I finish implementing the prototype and make sure it actually works and performs the way I'm hoping it will, so bear with me in the meantime.

notes.title: Update 0.1.4 - Spring mood in Vuntra City
notes.notes:
[b]Update 0.1.4 Notes[/b]

New additions:
 - Some sectors now feature blooming cherry trees, glowing versions included.
 - New SDF shader variant on billboards: Māui - Fragment III by KΛTUR.

Bug fixes:
 - Fixed issue with unique books leaving a ghost copy when you pick them up.
 - Fixed issue with elevator doors not spawning in multilevel interiors in certain scenarios
 - Improved sky tram route geometry (thanks to the glitchy seed found by YorVeX). By the way, if you find another glitchy seed with weird sky tram paths, don't hesitate to report it on Discord.

notes.title: Demo Patch 0.1.3 - Interior Stairs!
notes.notes:
[h2]Patch 0.1.3 Content[/h2]

This is a small patch to add stairs to the multilevel interiors. The stairs have a variety of models depending on the interior's quality level, and they only spawn if there is enough room.

Oh and another small change is the kitchens in bars and cafes will now spawn shelves instead of tables for a more industrial kitchen look.

notes.title: Demo Update 0.1.2 is here!
notes.notes:
[h2]0.1.2 Patch Notes[/h2]

[b]New Additions
[/b]
 - New room type: kitchen
 - New room type: storage room

[b]Fixes and improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Residential interior overhaul (apartments/hotels).
[list]
[*] Residential interiors are more likely to spawn on all floors except ground floor.
[*] Residential interiors are now more likely to contain bedrooms (and kitchens).
[*] Some furniture items like beds, couches, and armchairs are more likely to spawn by the wall rather than in the middle of their slot to improve layout realism. This is a work in progress and I am constantly looking for ways to make the interior layouts more realistic.
[/list]
[/list]
[list]
[*]  Fixed stutter when entering a vehicle or an elevator.
[*]  Fixed several furniture models that were missing LODs.
[*]  Elevators will now close their doors on delay rather than proximity.
[*]  Taxis will now leave after a delay as well as on proximity.
[*]  Some bar counters will now have beer taps.
[*]  Radio stations won't pick the same track twice in a row anymore.
[*]  Added a missing button press sound for the fireworks remote.
[/list]

[b]Also.[/b]

I just started a Patreon in case you guys would like to support the development of Vuntra City: patreon.com/LaraTheDev. I am currently funding the project with my own savings and don't have any investors or publishers, so any support is extremely valuable for me. Oh and let me know if there are any perks I could offer for my patrons that I hadn't considered.

notes.title: Demo Update 0.1.1 is now live!
notes.notes:
[b]Demo Patch 0.1.1 Notes[/b]

[b]New additions:[/b]
 - Street clocks - These are not just decorative, each one also has a panel that allows you to fast forward time by a selected interval
 - New interior type: Gym
[b]
Fixes:[/b]
 - Fixed stutter caused by book shelves, as well as a few more minor stutter sources. This is an ongoing task so expect more stutter and performance fixes in the future.
 - Increased map terminal spawn chance at sky tram stations.
 - Street props should now be less likely to block building entrances.
 - Improved VR hand magnet to have a more reliable direction and a slightly wider item detection radius.
 - Fixed concurrency issues with party music, so now only one party will be audible at a time.
 - Shops will now only spawn on ground floors of buildings. No more grocery shop penthouses!
 - The taxi terminals now have an animated indicator which makes them easier to identify.
 - Sprinting will now toggle itself off when the player stops, to be consistent with other games.
 - Building address plates are now less likely to get blocked by the building's architecture.
 - Improved collision detection for the firework station remotes, so they shouldn't fall through furniture anymore.
 - Adjusted vending machine item spawn points to make sure they spawn in a more accessible spot.
 - Removed the out of place hot dog stand texture. It's not ideal but I will probably change it if I decide to make them actually operational.
 - Fixed issue that prevented the items held in offhand from being used. That means you can now hold 2 firework remotes and use them at the same time!

notes.title: Environment Demo is Now Available!
notes.notes:
[h2]The Environment Demo is now available![/h2]

Exciting news! You can now explore Vuntra City in VR or flat screen! Take a relaxing walk through the city's streets, ride the public transport, or just chill at a cafe or a spa that catches your eye. The project is still in development, and there is still a lot of work to do, but I'm thrilled to show what I've built so far. 

The demo only showcases the procedural city environment and does not feature the full gameplay planned for the final release.

More information about the features and systems requirements for the demo can be found here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3586610/Vuntra_City_Environment_Demo/]Vuntra City Environment Demo on Steam[/url]

Join [url=https://discord.com/invite/UU3CbNnJDp]Vuntra City Discord[/url] for more information and feedback.

Have fun!
